channel.title: Boarders
channel.desc: The boarders are teamed up with career mentors, but things quickly go wrong. Leah is fuming with Felix about the sabotage, and Femi's dreams are crushed. Omar is in denial, and Toby is distracted by Abby's dangerous games. Violence erupts on the hockey pitch, and their bright futures feel further away than ever.
